away.summary: The Panthers (9-7-2) are missing several key players, including Aleksander Barkov and Brad Marchand, though both participated in morning skate and are within two weeks of returning. Jack Devine will make his season debut after being recalled from the AHL, while Dmitry Kulikov and Cole Reinhardt are scratched. Jacob Markstrom is projected to start in net.

home.summary: The Blue Jackets (7-8-0) will have Erik Gudbranson back in the lineup on defense, replacing Jake Christiansen. Ryan Lomberg replaces Conor Garland, who is injured. Cam Talbot is projected to start in goal. The team is coming off a 5-2 loss to the Buffalo Sabres.
